chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0418: Ji Ning Faces a Price So High Even the Bloodcloud Hall Flinches
chapter_meta_description: The Bloodcloud Hall cancels its contract on Ji Ning's life — re-pricing the hit at twenty Immortal treasures. Meanwhile, Diancai Immortal finally awakens from his tribulation.
og_description: The Bloodcloud Hall returns their payment and cancels the assassination. They say killing Ji Ning now costs twenty Immortal-ranked treasures. Even Ancestor Xuanji is stunned.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 0418 — 20 Treasures to Kill One Man
twitter_description: The Bloodcloud Hall just re-quoted the price on Ji Ning's life at twenty Immortal-ranked treasures. Xuanji rages. The Diancai Immortal awakens.

lore_anchors.definition: A Chinese social concept representing one's reputation, status, and dignity in public; losing face is a form of social defeat that can trigger withdrawal, hostility, or strategic retreat.
A legendary divine ability beneath the True God level; its suspected presence in Ji Ning signals he may have a Daofather-level backer, making him a terrifyingly high-risk target.
A spiritual trial that attacks a cultivator's Dao-heart with their deepest regrets and fears; duration is unpredictable and can last days to weeks.
A top-tier treasure within the Immortal grade of magical artifacts; twenty of these are equivalent in value to two Pure Yang treasures.
A treasure grade above Immortal-ranked, representing immense value and power. Two low-grade Pure Yang treasures could hire a True Immortal or Empyrean God.
A high-level escape talisman capable of teleporting the user across vast distances, used as a last-resort escape method.
A professional assassin organization in the Grand Xia world; they pride themselves on completing contracts but will cancel and refund if the price is wrong.
Ji Ning's divine sense technique, named after the primordial god Candle Dragon; a powerful perceptual ability.
